test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Points A and B are 200 km apart. A person starts from A at 10 a.m. at a speed of 10 km/h and goes towards B. Another person starts from B at 11 a.m.at a speed of 20 km/h and goes towards A. At what time will they meet?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Distance covered** by the first person in 1 hour (10 a.m. to 11 a.m.) = 10 × 1 = 10 km.

**Remaining distance** to be covered at 11 a.m. = 200 − 10 = 190 km.

**Relative speed** (moving towards each other) = 10 + 20 = 30 km/h.

**Time taken** to meet after 11 a.m. = 190 ÷ 30 = 6 hours 20 minutes.

Meeting time = 11:00 a.m. + 6 hours 20 minutes = 5:20 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:20 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 200 km

Speed of person from A (S₁) = 10 km/h (Starts at 10 a.m.)

Speed of person from B (S₂) = 20 km/h (Starts at 11 a.m.)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22b20619ad287320cd050d27fb3de0f47a5a37f964727bde2cc3bb7c4b7d9bd1.png] 

Step 1: Calculate the distance covered by the first person before the second person starts.

⇒ Distance covered in 1 hour = 10 km/h × 1 h = 10 km.

Step 2: Find the remaining distance between them at 11 a.m.

⇒ Remaining Distance = 200 − 10 = 190 km.

Step 3: Calculate the relative speed as they are moving towards each other.

⇒ Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂ = 10 + 20 = 30 km/h.

Step 4: Calculate the time required to cover the remaining distance.

⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time = 190 ÷ 30 = 19/3 hours

⇒ Time = 6 hours + (1/3) × 60 minutes = 6 hours 20 minutes.

Step 5: Determine the final meeting time.

⇒ Meeting Time = 11:00 a.m. + 6 hours 20 minutes = 5:20 p.m.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:20 p.m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move towards each other, relative speed is the **sum of their individual speeds** (S₁ + S₂). If they move in the same direction, it is the **difference** (|S₁ − S₂|).

Synchronization of Time

Before applying the relative speed formula, always ensure both objects are calculated from the **same starting time** by finding the distance one has already covered.

Time, Speed, and Distance Formula

The fundamental relation is **Distance = Speed × Time**. Ensure units are consistent (e.g., km and km/h or m and m/s).</p
